mechanism: Ibuprofen may reduce renal clearance of tolterodine metabolites and both drugs have anticholinergic effects that can be additive; NSAIDs also increase risk of renal impairment affecting tolterodine elimination.
action: Monitor renal function and tolterodine efficacy; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesic if prolonged NSAID use needed, especially in elderly or those with renal compromise.
